title: hopea selanica
intro: Hopea selanica, commonly known as Selan Tree, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is a tropical tree native to Southeast Asia, prized for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Hopea selanica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-diabetic, and antimicrobial properties due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids.
